claims.sentence: In 2025 and 2026, references to works that do not exist were found in papers accepted at NeurIPS \citep{ansari2026compound,russinovich2026phantom}, ACL identified more than 100 accepted papers citing non-existent literature during camera-ready checks \citep{acl2026statement}, and ICLR and ICML now treat such references as grounds for desk rejection \citep{iclr2026response,russinovich2026phantom}.
claims.claim: References to non-existent works were found in papers accepted at NeurIPS (2025).
claims.excerpt: This study analyzes 100 AIgenerated hallucinated citations that appeared in papers accepted by the 2025 Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS), one of the world’s most prestigious AI conferences. Despite review by 3–5 expert researchers per paper, these fabricated citations evaded detection, appearing in 53 published papers (≈1% of all accepted papers).
claims.note: Supported for the clause it closes. Note the detection itself was done by GPTZero (Sec. 2.1); Ansari analyses GPTZero's dataset, which the passive 'were found' does not misstate.
